approved_checks.subject: Start eligibility and order
approved_checks.result: Each eligible owner starts only after successful configuration ensure and runtime decoding. Non-debug still loads and validates runtime, then emits no root record. Pre-start failure leaves the session inactive. Main does not start for quiet config, help/version/parse failure, auth export, hidden auth callback or FANBOX auth. Startup hooks run before scope attachment, matching frozen root order.

approved_checks.subject: Canonical operations and module
approved_checks.result: Ordinary Clap command paths come from parsed matches before user/novel search command transformation. Auth paths come from parsed command variants. FANBOX path comes from existing route selection. Dictionary path now comes from parsed Operation through leaf_name, reused by diagnostics and automatic metadata. Root FANBOX records use FANBOX CLI; other owners use Pixiv CLI.

approved_checks.subject: Business and automatic-check context
approved_checks.result: Scoped concrete Context is passed to normal business execution, FANBOX reads/download/MCP, dictionary, download and auth; post-success callbacks and generic automatic_result receive the same root diagnostic scope. SystemUpdateHost::automatic has no session and therefore does not create an extra start/finish pair. Automatic checks run before outer command finish.

approved_checks.subject: Explicit update CallerContext
approved_checks.result: The new default UpdatePreparation port preserves existing implementers. Main override decorates the caller after startup and diagnostic start, before coordinator execution. ScopedContext delegates error, deadline, cancelled future, value and extension to its parent and replaces only scope. Source mapping is consistent with frozen scope replacement; this review does not prove every actual checker constructor observes it.

approved_checks.subject: Finish ownership and cleanup
approved_checks.result: There is one outer finish call for each possible started owner: update, FANBOX, download, auth, dictionary or ordinary dispatch. execute closes tracked execution/database resources after automatic checks and before returning to main finish. Reverse search and retained FANBOX read/download databases close before their owner returns. Download explicitly aggregates its retained database close result. Auth and MCP service values drop before returning to outer finish, but broader Close-error aggregation remains debt.

approved_checks.subject: MCP stream separation
approved_checks.result: Root Presenter writer is bound solely to io::stderr; scoped MCP contexts do not reroute diagnostics to JSON-RPC stdout. Existing main MCP serve calls retain stdout for transport and the new outer finish writes its records through stderr. The actual MCP smoke rows in this focused suite fail proxy validation before server startup, so this is source-reviewed separation rather than a complete live stdio run.

approved_checks.subject: Owned process isolation
approved_checks.result: Root tests are Linux-only, use temporary working directory/HOME/USERPROFILE/XDG directories and env_clear, synthetic account bytes, disabled automatic update, and existing seccomp socket/connect denial. No native desktop, registry/HKCU, real accounts, browser or external service effect is established or needed. The helper extension only adds specified environment values before installing the existing denial boundary.

approved_checks.result: Two primary fixture rows compare exit, full stdout and full stderr after validating and replacing only clock spans. Added dictionary test seals fixture SHA and all eight rows, compares exit/full stdout/full stderr/config and absence of DB/cache. Routing smoke checks full root-event fields and record ordering, but is not a full Go-observation projection. No fixture-name branch or expected-output lookup is added to production.
